requirements.assertions: The island reads the unchanged v0.1 SQLite history, retention and count. Accepted history text is copied exactly; v0.1 exclusions, protected formats and sensitive checks remain unchanged. Search never reads the OS clipboard.

Existing Fuse search combines All/Text/Links/Images/Files/Pinned with persisted query/filter/list scroll and truthful total/latest500 shown count. Typed file/image fixtures prove filters; new file/image capture/classification remains V5.11.

Bare1-9 selects/copies; Ctrl+C copies; arrows/Home/End select; Enter pastes; Delete removes; Ctrl+F focuses/selects the query. Numeric query text, selected-text copying, IME, modifiers, repeats and single-flight actions remain safe. Global Ctrl1-6/Alt1-9/Esc/Tab routing stays green.

The production pick core uses injected copy/focus/input ports in Rust and browser tests. A ticket binds the original external HWND/PID and request ID to the live focus lease. Stale targets fail before write; missing lease, changed focus, denied restore or failed input falls back to copied-only without collapse. Success sends copy/restore/paste/collapse in order. Windows adapter compiles; automation never invokes it.

Pin/delete reuse v1 commands and SQLite. Manual additions, copy/pin/delete/clear, tray-menu mutations and retention changes publish clipboard:changed. Listener-before-snapshot, revision invalidation, late cleanup and StrictMode tests protect mount/unmount; no collapsed JavaScript polling.
Each URL row opens the existing explicit download review. No media download starts. V4.9 Save/Clean/Open/video context remains. No clipboard or shell side effect is invoked by a screenshot fixture.

Fresh high-fidelity Figma9:330 plus expanded/tray reference.40 repeat-exact captures at1x/1.5x and light/dark (always-dark island) measure all15 original SVGs and bundled Geist, with default axe zero violations/incompletes. Empty/loading/error states retain grid semantics and a hidden heading. Unsupported images show an honest missing-preview tile and reject writes.

Owned custom-protocol release uses actual Tauri IPC and isolated SQLite for read/add/pin/event rendering, with a stable native DPR2 capture. No OS clipboard/global input, user account, browser profile or display setting is used. Initial island JS is below120000 gzip bytes; no dependency or sidecar is added.

limits.images: The v0.1 watcher remains text/URL-only. Image rows are filterable/pinnable with optional bounded raster data previews; image copying is rejected before OS writes. Stored local/remote blob paths are never opened for previews.
limits.files: Typed file history copies path text, not file-drop payloads. This task does not extend the legacy classifier.
limits.paste: The Windows arboard/SetForegroundWindow/SendInput adapter is compiled, with production decisions tested through recording providers. Real OS clipboard/input and foreground grants are not exercised under section0.2.
limits.platforms: This x64 Windows host only; previous V0/V2 focus/performance and external-platform limits remain.
limits.later: V5.2 Shelf next; V5.11 classifier/context and V6.3 tray redesign remain unchecked.
